reason: A native DSH plugin for coordinating independent Sessions and provider-backed AI members through persistent Rooms, direct messaging, broadcasts, membership management, and native UI surfaces.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供原生协作房间，用于连接独立会话和提供方支持的 AI 成员并进行消息协调与成员管理。
summaries.en: Provides native DeepSeek Harness Rooms for connecting independent Sessions and provider-backed AI members with messaging, broadcasting, and membership management.

capabilities: Creates and manages persistent multi-member Rooms
Attaches existing Sessions or provider-backed members
Sends direct messages and broadcasts through member providers
Can request provider-owned interruption when removing members or closing Rooms
Adds native DSH UI actions, modal management, and member mention selection
Stores bounded membership and delivery metadata
